Rice.name: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
Rice.control: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2 ml/L

Rice.name: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
Rice.control: Validamycin 3% L @ 2.5 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L

Rice.name: Brown Planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens)
Rice.control: Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 0.6 g/L or Triflumezopyrim 10% SC @ 0.5 ml/L

Rice.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
Rice.control: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L

Wheat.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust (Puccinia striiformis)
Wheat.control: Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/L at first notice

Wheat.name: Brown / Leaf Rust (Puccinia triticina)
Wheat.control: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L

Wheat.name: Powdery Mildew (Blumeria graminis)
Wheat.control: Wettable Sulphur 80% WP @ 3 g/L or Propiconazole @ 1 ml/L

Wheat.name: Wheat Aphids (Sitobion avenae)
Wheat.control: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.2 g/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L

Cotton.name: Pink Bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella)
Cotton.control: Pheromone traps (8/ha) + Profenofos 50% EC @ 2 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L

Cotton.name: Whitefly & Leaf Curl Vector (Bemisia tabaci)
Cotton.control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 2 ml/L

Cotton.name: Bacterial Blight (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
Cotton.control: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline 100 ppm

Cotton.name: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum)
Cotton.control: Trichoderma viride soil application @ 2.5 kg/ha in FYM

Maize.name: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda)
Maize.control: Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 0.5 ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4 ml/L

Maize.name: Maydis Leaf Blight (Bipolaris maydis)
Maize.control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L

Maize.name: Stem Borer (Chilo partellus)
Maize.control: Carbofuran 3G granules @ 7.5 kg/ha or Chlorantraniliprole @ 0.4 ml/L

Sugarcane.name: Red Rot (Colletotrichum falcatum)
Sugarcane.control: Use healthy seed setts treated with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 g/L; ensure drainage

Sugarcane.name: Top Borer (Scirpophaga excerptalis)
Sugarcane.control: Chlorantraniliprole 0.4% G @ 18 kg/ha at shoot emergence

Sugarcane.name: Sugarcane Smut (Sporisorium scitamineum)
Sugarcane.control: Rogue out infected whips; spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L

Potato.name: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
Potato.control: Prophylactic Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L; post-outbreak Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 3 g/L

Potato.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
Potato.control: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L

Potato.name: Potato Aphids (Myzus persicae)
Potato.control: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L or Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2 g/L

Tomato.name: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
Tomato.control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin @ 1 ml/L

Tomato.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (Whitefly vector)
Tomato.control: Yellow sticky traps + Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L

Tomato.name: Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
Tomato.control: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L or Chlorantraniliprole @ 0.4 ml/L

Mustard.name: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi)
Mustard.control: Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.2 g/L

Mustard.name: Alternaria Blight (Alternaria brassicae)
Mustard.control: Iprodione 50% WP @ 2 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L

Soybean.name: Soybean Rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi)
Soybean.control: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L

Soybean.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus (Whitefly vector)
Soybean.control: Acetamiprid 20% SP @ 0.2 g/L or Thiamethoxam @ 0.2 g/L

Groundnut.name: Tikka Leaf Spot (Cercospora arachidicola)
Groundnut.control: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Chlorothalonil @ 2 g/L

Gram.name: Ascochyta Blight (Ascochyta rabiei)
Gram.control: Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Carbendazim @ 1 g/L

Gram.name: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ciceris)
Gram.control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed

Gram.name: Gram Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera)
Gram.control: Pheromone traps (5/ha) + Indoxacarb 14.5% SC @ 1 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate @ 0.5 g/L

Pulses.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus (Mungbean YMV)
Pulses.control: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 ml/L to control whiteflies

Pulses.name: Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe polygoni)
Pulses.control: Wettable Sulphur 80% WP @ 3 g/L or Hexaconazole @ 1.5 ml/L

Pulses.name: Pod Borer Complex
Pulses.control: Chlorantraniliprole @ 0.3 ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2 ml/L

Onion.name: Purple Blotch (Alternaria porri)
Onion.control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Tebuconazole @ 1 ml/L

Onion.name: Onion Thrips (Thrips tabaci)
Onion.control: Fipronil 5% SC @ 1.5 ml/L or Spinosad 45% SC @ 0.3 ml/L

Chilli.name: Anthracnose / Die-back (Colletotrichum capsici)
Chilli.control: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L or Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L

Chilli.name: Chilli Thrips & Yellow Mite
Chilli.control: Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1 ml/L

Apple.name: Apple Scab (Venturia inaequalis)
Apple.control: Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.3 ml/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L

Apple.name: Powdery Mildew (Podosphaera leucotricha)
Apple.control: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 0.5 ml/L or Wettable Sulphur @ 2.5 g/L

Apple.name: San Jose Scale (Diaspidiotus perniciosus)
Apple.control: Dormant spray with Horticultural Mineral Oil (HMO) @ 20 ml/L

Coconut.name: Rhinoceros Beetle (Oryctes rhinoceros)
Coconut.control: Hook extraction from crown; apply Phorate 10G or neem cake mixture to leaf axils

Coconut.name: Red Palm Weevil (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus)
Coconut.control: Pheromone lures (Ferrolure+) + crown stem injection with Imidacloprid @ 3 ml/tree

Coconut.name: Bud Rot (Phytophthora palmivora)
Coconut.control: Bordeaux paste application on crown; spray Bordeaux mixture 1% before monsoon
